segments.title: Pre-Show Setup & Mod Configuration
segments.notes: Case configures Lethal Company mods (BiggerLobby, BepInEx, Goku Bracken) and coordinates invites for a 16-player lobby while troubleshooting audio bleed with Kendelle in the same room.

segments.title: Early Expeditions: Experimentation & Offense
segments.notes: Crew learns modded mechanics — sonic thumper audio glitch, Goku Bracken ultra-instinct music — suffers multiple wipes on Experimentation, then moves to Offense for first successful quota runs.

segments.title: Dine & Titan Rotations, Crew Expansion
segments.notes: Roster grows to 13+ players (Fancy, Foxy, Radium, John, Amir, Tim, Kyle); crew tackles Dine fire exits, Titan stormy conditions, and door-muncher mimics while managing ladder economy and turret gauntlets.

segments.title: High-Stakes Loot Runs & Near-Total Wipes
segments.notes: Multiple jack-in-the-box and nutcracker ambushes decimate crew; Case micromanages teleporter purchases, shovel distribution, and body recovery while quota surpasses 1,000 credits.

segments.title: Final Quota Push & Giant Encounters
segments.notes: Last day on Titan: crew navigates eclipse dogs, spring-heads, and earth leviathans; Fancy distinguishes himself as primary combatant; Case secures final loot haul before sign-off.

segments.title: Live Proposal, Raid Farewell & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Case proposes to Kendelle on air at 04:28:59; she accepts. Case raids Fiona's channel, announces Cream Team podcast for tomorrow noon, confirms standard news return Wednesday.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored a four-hour Lethal Company marathon and proposed to Kendelle on live broadcast.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: Co-piloted the Lethal Company expedition from the studio floor and accepted Case's on-air marriage proposal.

lore_notes.fact: Case Blackwell proposes to Kendelle on live broadcast; she accepts.
Case announces Cream Team podcast with Fiona scheduled for tomorrow noon.
Case confirms return to standard news broadcast Wednesday.

episode_summary: Anchor Case Blackwell hosted an extended Lethal Company marathon with a rotating crew of correspondents and contributors, culminating in a live on-air marriage proposal to in-studio contributor Kendelle. The broadcast featured multiple high-casualty expeditions to moons including Experimentation, Offense, Dine, and Titan, with the crew securing substantial quota surpluses despite repeated wipes. Blackwell closed the broadcast confirming a Cream Team podcast for the following day and a return to standard news programming Wednesday.
